overview: Server-side anticheats see S04 only on send, and the real consumers split into two groups. State mirrors keep the simulated entity copy honest: Grim reads the packet in PacketEntityReplication and applies it through CompensatedEntities on the transaction clock. Countermeasure modules rewrite the outgoing payload so other clients cannot scout gear: Photon's information hiders and Intave's EquipmentFilter. The rest of the corpus is keyword noise: Rammelkast, NCP UseItemAdapter and LightAntiCheat hit on org.bukkit.inventory.EquipmentSlot armor reads inside movement checks, Artemis and Negativity contribute wrappers and registrations, and the Peyang and MinecraftAntiCheat NPC bait code sends the packet to fake entities, which is a send-side use, not a check.

checks.name: Entity equipment replication (Grim)
checks.purpose: Keeps the compensated entity copy's equipment mirror in sync with the server so checks that depend on other players' gear (elytra gliding, attack range, horse saddle state) evaluate the right items at the right tick.
checks.how_it_works: PacketEntityReplication reads WrapperPlayServerEntityEquipment on the ENTITY_EQUIPMENT send and schedules updateEntityEquipment as a real-time task on the transaction clock (lastTransactionSent), so the equipment change lands exactly when the client would have processed it. CompensatedEntities guards on the trackEntityEquipment flag, then folds each Equipment entry into the packet entity through setItemBySlot. PacketEntityHorse and PacketEntityNautilus enable tracking because saddle state is movement-relevant, and PacketEntityHappyGhast tracks its body slot.
checks.detects: Nothing directly: this is state replication. It removes equipment desync as a variable from checks that reason about what a tracked entity holds or rides.
checks.variations: The packet read lives in Grim PacketEntityReplication lines 161-162, the same transaction sandwich used for the metadata and player-info branches. No other anticheat mirrors other entities' equipment into a simulation.

checks.name: Information hider (Photon)
checks.purpose: Anti-ESP countermeasure: rewrite outgoing S04 payloads so other clients cannot infer a player's gear from durability, enchantments, lore or item counts.
checks.how_it_works: InformationHiderModule registers a HIGH-priority send listener on ENTITY_EQUIPMENT, parses the wrapper, skips the player's own entity, and hands every equipped item to the abstract hideInformation hook. DurabilityHider, EnchantmentHider and ItemCountHider subclass it, and PacketInformationHider routes the ENTITY_EQUIPMENT case by entity id for the visibility system. The server still sees the real items; only the forwarded copies are stripped.
checks.detects: Nothing: this is a protection module, not a violation check. It defeats client-side gear scouting such as enchantment and durability ESP that a server-side anticheat cannot observe directly.
checks.variations: Photon's LegacyPlayerEquipmentHider and ModernPlayerEquipmentHider replace the equipment list with empty stacks for hidden players. No other anticheat rewrites S04 payloads.

checks.name: Equipment filter (Intave)
checks.purpose: The same countermeasure family as Photon: strip enchantments, display names, lore and book contents from outgoing equipment packets so clients cannot scout items.
checks.how_it_works: EquipmentFilter subscribes to the ENTITY_EQUIPMENT outbound packet and rewrites the payload in place: amounts are set to 1, enchantments are removed and replaced with a single THORNS marker, book title and pages are cleared, firework effects are emptied, and display name and lore are blanked. It handles both the legacy single-item layout (1.8-1.15) and the slot-pair list layout (1.16+). The clone ships with enabled() returning false, so the filter is compiled but inactive by default.
checks.detects: Nothing: a defensive filter. It prevents other players' clients from reading real equipment data off the wire.
checks.variations: Intave's FakePlayer equipment actions (EquipmentArmorAction, EquipmentHeldItemAction) send S04 to bait NPCs instead of filtering it. Peyang and network-dev MinecraftAntiCheat NPC code also send S04 with armor stacks to fake entities; those are bait sends, not checks.
